projects.name: CTDOT Project Work Areas
projects.notes: CTDOT Open Data capital project work-area POLYGONS, all stages from planning to closed. CurrentSchedulePhase (numbered values, see list) separates planning/design from construction and completed; STIPstatusDescription says whether the project is in the STIP; CurrentADVdate is the advertising date, EstConstrCompletionDate the estimated completion; DesignPercentComplete, CurrentConstructionEstimate, ROWExpenditures (right-of-way spending) also present. There is no work-type field (use Title/ProjectDescription). Location is Towns (comma-separated), no county.

parcels_statewide.name: Connecticut CAMA and Parcel Layer (CT GIS Office)
parcels_statewide.restrictions: ArcGIS Online item licence is CC0 (public domain); no restriction stated.
parcels_statewide.notes: Statewide parcels joined to municipal CAMA (assessor) data, collected annually from all towns through the Councils of Governments (C.G.S. 7-100l); current layer is the 2026 collection (Parcel_Collection_Year / CAMA_Collection_Year). Owner, Co_Owner and mailing address present; completeness varies by town. No single total market value: Appraised_Land + Appraised_Building + Appraised_Outbuilding are appraised values and Assessed_Total is the 70% assessed total. Connecticut has no county government: Town_Name is the municipality, COG the planning region. CAMA_Link is the join key; Parcel_ID is the town's local id. Year-specific copies exist as Connecticut_CAMA_and_Parcel_Layer_2025 / _2024.
parcels_statewide.approved_note: Approved by the account owner on 2026-11-17: no restriction on commercial use stated.

summary: CTDOT Project Work Areas polygons cover planning through completed projects (phase, cost, advertising date; no work-type field), and the CT GIS Office statewide CAMA and Parcel layer has owner and mailing address under CC0.
